# PG Manager

> Free web app for PG (Paying Guest) and Hostel management. Handles beds, tenants, rent collection, expenses, complaints, analytics, and staff attendance.

## What it does

PG Manager is a complete management dashboard for PG/Hostel owners. It runs entirely in the browser with Supabase as the backend.

### Core Features
- **Bed & Room Management**: Add rooms, set beds per room, assign individual bed rents
- **Tenant Management**: Add tenants, assign beds, track check-in/check-out dates, phone numbers
- **Rent Tracking**: Monthly rent ledger per tenant, mark payments, track due amounts and security deposits
- **Expense Tracking**: Categorize expenses (electricity, food, maintenance, etc.), monthly summaries
- **Complaints**: Log and resolve tenant complaints with priority levels
- **Dashboard Analytics**: Collection heatmap, revenue per room, payment behavior, profit & loss statements
- **Staff Attendance**: Track housekeeping/maintenance staff daily presence
- **Data Import**: Smart import from Excel/CSV/Google Sheets — auto-detects column mappings
- **Export**: Generate PDF reports, send WhatsApp rent reminders
- **Dark/Light Theme**: Full dark and light mode support
- **Mobile-First**: Bottom tab navigation on phone, dashboard grid on desktop

### Tech Stack
- Frontend: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript (no framework)
- Backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Realtime)
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages
- Auth: Email/password via Supabase Auth
